warning: Synthetic reactive simulation only, not live win probability, leaderboard rating or a calibrated forecast. Fixed deal/tie streams pair model worlds; rivals react to each policy. CPU-dependent search cutoffs, instant actions, missing transport latency and synthetic rival policies limit realism.
